mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS declines do not correlate with subsequent economic downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent economic expansions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the combination signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and increasing PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent economic expansions.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is increasing and real GDP (GDPC1) is above its 12-month moving average, the combination signals a strong supply-side and economic growth environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of increasing INDPRO and GDPC1 above its 12-month MA does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
